tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search Staylonger extended-stay rental properties in Australia by location, dates, guest count, bedrooms and one feature such as pet-friendly or on-site parking. Returns up to 10 matching listings with pricing, the property id for the other tools, and a link to each property page.

tools.name: search_locations
tools.description: Look up Australian suburbs, cities or postcodes by free-text query. Use this to confirm a location name before searching properties.

tools.name: get_property_details
tools.description: Get full details for a Staylonger property by id: description, bedrooms/bathrooms, guest capacity, price, features such as pet-friendly or on-site parking, amenities, reviews and the property page URL.

tools.name: check_property_availability
tools.description: Check which days of a month are available to book for a Staylonger property, with the nightly price and minimum stay on each. Defaults to the current month.

tools.name: get_property_quote
tools.description: Get a priced quote for a Staylonger property for a specific date range and guest count, with a link to book those dates.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_properties" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
